anchor.title: The Federal Reserve holds interest rates at 3.75%–4%
anchor.why: The Fed kept rates where they've been since September's increase, saying inflation "remains elevated."

cards.title: Intel's stock plunges about 29% in one day
cards.why: It fell on Friday, the day after disappointing results from Intel and Amazon added to worries about how much tech companies are spending on AI.

cards.title: Lula wins Brazil's presidential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro
cards.why: Brazil voted on Sunday, the first event of the week. Lula won about 51.7% of the vote, and Bolsonaro refused to accept the result.

cards.title: A local ceasefire begins around Russian-occupied Oleshky, Ukraine
cards.why: It started on Tuesday so food and medicine could reach about 2,000 residents still in the city. It's local, not a ceasefire for the whole war.

cards.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde announces she'll step down early
cards.why: She announced it on Thursday, the day after the Fed's decision, as the European Central Bank held its rates at 2.5%. She'll leave on February 7, 2027.

cards.title: AI company Anthropic makes its plan to go public official
cards.why: Its IPO paperwork became public on Monday, the day after Brazil's vote. Going public means anyone can buy shares in the company.

questions.prompt: Israel held a national election on October 27. What did the count show?
options: Netanyahu's bloc won a clear majority
The opposition won a clear majority
No bloc reached the 61 seats needed for a majority
questions.explanation: With over 99% counted, Netanyahu's bloc had 53 of 120 seats and the opposition bloc 48, so both sides now need coalition partners.

questions.prompt: Two Fed officials voted against holding rates steady on October 28. What did they want instead?
options: To end the Fed's inflation goal
questions.explanation: Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack wanted a quarter-point increase, because inflation is still well above the Fed's 2% goal.

questions.prompt: About how much cryptocurrency was stolen in the Binance hack this week?
questions.explanation: Analysts at TRM Labs and Chainalysis estimate about $6.3–6.4 billion and link the attack to a North Korean state-backed hacking group.

questions.prompt: Which team won its first-ever World Series on October 28?
questions.explanation: The Brewers beat the Rays 4–1 in Game 5. Neither team had ever won a World Series before.

questions.prompt: Going into the November 3 midterms, how many seats would Democrats need to gain to win control of the House?
questions.explanation: Republicans hold the House 218–214, so a net gain of just 3 seats would give Democrats the majority.
